_comment: Copy to appsettings.json (gitignored) and fill in the passwords. Ports match docker-compose.yml, which remaps Postgres to 5433 and MySQL to 3308 so the stack cannot collide with a server already installed on the machine. Leave a string empty to skip that dialect's tests; a non-empty string that cannot connect fails them instead. JAUNTY_TEST_SQLSERVER / _POSTGRESQL / _MYSQL / _MARIADB take priority over this file. AllowPublicKeyRetrieval=true is required by MySqlConnector (Jaunty.Scaffolding.Tests) against MySQL 8 default auth over an unencrypted connection; MySql.Data (Jaunty.Tests) does not need it, so omitting it skips only the scaffolding schema-reader tests.
